ideas.pitch: A streamlined platform designed specifically for Brainwaves hackathon participants to structure, format, and auto-generate compliance-ready PPT submissions for Stage 1.
ideas.title: Brainwaves Prototype Evaluator & Submission Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the specific structural workflow mandated by the organizers (Stage 1 PPT and problem-solution alignment) appeals directly to the evaluators looking for strict adherence to guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight dashboard built for 3-4 member hackathon teams to track active git contributions, split feature development, and generate instant demo scripts.
ideas.title: CollabTrack: Team Contribution & Milestone Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organizers explicitly stated that teamwork and active contribution from every member are key evaluation criteria; this tool directly visualizes and proves team equity.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted slide deck generator that transforms raw code repositories and project notes into professional judging presentations using the required event template.
ideas.title: InsightSlide: Automated Hackathon Presentation Builder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Stage 1 deliverables (PPT submission), solving a major pain point for teams racing against a 24-48 hour clock.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative backlog manager tailored for tight hackathon deadlines, featuring live voting on MVP features to prevent scope creep.
ideas.title: ProtoSync: Real-time Feature Triage for Rapid Prototyping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes practical software development and robust collaboration, aligning with Brainwaves' core evaluation metrics.

ideas.pitch: An in-browser recorder that helps teams bundle their working prototype, architecture diagram, and presentation into a single polished submission package.
ideas.title: DemoFlow: Instant Video & Artifact Pitch Recorder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures a polished, working live demo presentation—a proven winning pattern at fast-paced software hackathons.
